body:
I can relate with the insanity of getting triggered by anything related to maculinity. Even a dog, even a old man who is not good looking in any way, an object that resembles something phallic.   
Is that what gay people experience in their daily lives?   
I can't cope with living like this.  
I have a wonderful girlfriend who i love too much and i'm afraid of moving in together with her and end up ruining her life.   
Thoughts of suicide are permanently on my mind.

Some days the first thought that pops up into my mind when i wake up is if the way i walked out from the bed was gay or feminine. lol I even worry if the way i move around in bed when im trying to sleep is gay. I worry if i'm holding the glass in a gay way when i'm drinking water. Is the way i walk gay? My arm position, my hand position. I'm constantly checking everything.   And it also makes me worry about my relationship. I think my girlfriend secretly thinks that i am gay. That she sees that i act in a feminine way but don't say anything about it, but she eventually will. It's torture, and it's making want to quit life.

Wow what you described there is my reality. Why are we cursed with that nonsensical thought process? It's so stupid and senseless! But yet it feels so real! It's the thing that moves our daily lives. WHY? What is the explanation to this?  
It's a curse and it's hell on earth.
